text: 宁德时代公告，公司发布2026年A股第二期员工持股计划（草案），首次授予参加对象为中层管理人员及核心骨干人员共5960人，受让价格（含预留）为158.42元/股，资金总额不超过12.8亿元，股份来源为公司回购专用证券账户回购的A股普通股，规模不超过808.16万股，占目前公司总股本46.27亿股的0.175%，其中预留股份170万股，占本持股计划总股数的21.04%。存续期60个月，首次授予分三期解锁，每期锁定期12个月，总锁定期36个月，解锁比例分别为30%、30%、40%。
text_en: CATL announced that the company has released the draft of its 2026 second-phase A-share employee stock ownership plan. The initial grant recipients are 5,960 mid-level managers and core key personnel. The transfer price (including reserved shares) is RMB 158.42 per share, with total funds not exceeding RMB 1.28 billion. The shares come from A-share ordinary shares repurchased by the company through its dedicated repurchase securities account, with a scale not exceeding 8.0816 million shares, accounting for 0.175% of the company's current total share capital of 4.627 billion shares. Among these, 1.7 million shares are reserved, accounting for 21.04% of the total shares under this plan. The duration is 60 months. The initial grant vests in three tranches, each with a 12-month lock-up period and a total lock-up period of 36 months, with vesting ratios of 30%, 30%, and 40%, respectively.
